During the last [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]'s [[Desolator crisis|campaign]] of vengeance against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], part of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the Republic, Imperial forces '''attacked''' the Republic [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] ''[[Daybreaker]]'' in the [[Uphrades system/Legends|Uphrades system]]. The ''Daybreaker'' had been crippled during the [[Devastation of Uphrades|devastation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uphrades]] by the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], and Angral's forces attacked the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to eliminate witnesses. However, a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] and crew arrived in-system aboard their [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]] and came to the rescue of the ''Daybreaker'', defeating the Imperial boarding party. The ''Daybreaker'' would later purposely maroon itself on the surface of Uphrades in order to aid the survivors of the catastrophe, while the Knight followed [[Darth Angral]] and the superweapon to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].

==Prelude==
In [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]'s son [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] was killed.
